title: Embedding a system of abelian sheaves on an inverse system of sites into a system of injectives
statement: In the situation of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites] (a cofiltered category $\mathcal I$, sites $\mathcal C_i$ whose coverings have finite index sets, morphisms of sites $f_a:\mathcal C_j\to\mathcal C_i$ for $a:j\to i$ given by continuous functors $u_a:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C_j$ with $u_b\circ u_a=u_{a\circ b}$, the colimit site $\mathcal C=\varinjlim\mathcal C_i$ with the canonical functors $u_i:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C$, $u_j\circ u_a=u_i$, and the morphisms of sites $f_i:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C_i$ they define [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]), let $\mathcal F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $\mathcal C_i$ for every $i$ and $\varphi_a:f_a^{-1}\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F_j$ ($a:j\to i$) maps of abelian sheaves with $\varphi_{a\circ b}=\varphi_b\circ f_b^{-1}\varphi_a$. Then there are abelian sheaves $\mathcal G_i$ on $\mathcal C_i$, maps $\psi_a:f_a^{-1}\mathcal G_i\to\mathcal G_j$ with $\psi_{a\circ b}=\psi_b\circ f_b^{-1}\psi_a$, and injective maps of abelian sheaves $\gamma_i:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal G_i$ forming a map of systems ($\psi_a\circ f_a^{-1}\gamma_i=\gamma_j\circ\varphi_a$ for all $a:j\to i$), such that every $\mathcal G_i$ is an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C_i)$. (Stacks' construction: $\mathcal G_i=\prod_{b:k\to i}f_{b*}\mathcal A_k$ for chosen injective embeddings $\mathcal F_k\to\mathcal A_k$; $f_{b*}$ preserves injectives because $f_b^{-1}$ is exact, and products of injectives are injective.)

proof.text: Use Mathlib enough injectives to take A_j=Injective.under(Fs j) and its monic inclusion i_j. Construct explicitly B_j as the product of R_t A_k over t:j→k and G_j=A_j×B_j.

Apply exactness of abelian inverse image to each transition functor and the right-adjoint injective preservation theorem. Every factor R_t A_k is injective, so B_j and its binary product with A_j are injective.

Apply the product transition construction to obtain ψ and its cocycle and compatibility with γ_j=((1-e_j)i_j,d_j). The objects G_j and embeddings γ_j are the explicit products and lifts defined in the proof. The existential transition statement is used only to prove the existential target; no library definition chooses arbitrary data from it.

Define r_j:G_j→A_j as first projection plus second projection followed by the identity-arrow projection and E_j at A_j. Product projection equations and naturality of E_j give γ_j r_j=(1-e_j)i_j+e_j i_j=i_j. Since i_j is mono, γ_j is mono by mono_of_mono_fac. Combine injectivity, monicity, cocycle and compatibility.
